carry_forward_caveat: INA measures 0/62 BY CONSTRUCTION: a week-1 inactive did not take a week-1 snap. That number says NOTHING about week 2 and must never be used as a week-2 prior. A week-1 INA player is a 53-man roster member, so his week-2 class is ACTIVE_ROSTER_EXPECTED and his prior is the ACT rate. The injury-persistence adjustment that would refine this is NOT IDENTIFIED from one week of data and is left unmeasured rather than guessed.
question: P(offensive snaps > 0 in the SAME week | nflverse weekly-roster status that week), skill positions only. This is a SAME-WEEK rate. It is NOT a week-to-week persistence rate and must not be used as one -- see carry_forward_caveat.
unknown_prior_basis: A player known only to be on the membership file gets the MARGINAL rate over all members, not 0 and not 1.
